The '''Tefau system''' was located in the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the location [[Tefau]].<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tefau [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-9.<ref name="TEA" />
